notes.title: Demo Update 0.5.0
notes.notes:
The Demo has been Updated with brand new features and new Better functionality.

Bugfixes;
[list]
[*] Accidentally starting a new game has been removed
[*] Te-Ra's Fire Vortex attack should now be more visable
[/list]

Features;
[list]
[*] Maui can now transform into four different animals, each with their own ability:
[list]
[*] Rupe (Pigeon) is now temporary and allows for quicker movement over terrain.
[*] Ngarara (Dragonfly) gives Maui a brief period of invulnerability.
[*] Hake (Hawk) Maui quickly dive bombs to deal moderate amount of damage
[*] Mangopare (Hammerhead Shark) attacks with large amount of damage and knocks back with large amount of force
[/list]
[*] Upon death Whiro will now rise out of the ground before the death window appears
[/list]

Updates
[list]
[*] Visual updates
[*] Optimization updates
[/list]

notes.title: Demo 0.4.1 Update
notes.notes:
Kia Ora

Finally a major update to the Demo brings us to v0.4.1
This is huge as you will see a shift in game play to a more linear style level that still leaves plenty of room for exploration.
For Now you will only get to experience one level which at the end will lead you to a fight with Te-Ra, the sun.
Another major update is to the combat system. Time your attacks to link combos, In the demo you will also get to try out using a transformation combo, demonstrating Maui's ability to turn the tides of battle. Don't worry you can still turn into Rupe at will and fly around.
Finally you'll see the terrifying Maero.

Thank you all for your patience as I continue to work on LoM and can't wait to show some of the new things as I progress.

notes.title: Major Update and Rework of Demo
notes.notes:
I hope you all have had some fun with the the [i]The Legends of Maui[/i] demo.
After doing some thinking and talking to other I am having to a major rework of the game and a new version of the demo will be coming out.
On a scale of how f'ed am I out of 10 I am looking at a 6. However I feel this is the right direction.
Here's hoping these changes improve the game and QoL
[olist]
[*] The controls should feel more in line with similar games
[*] Attacks are now to be chained in combos
[*] Scaling back the RPG elements to be more simple and less of a cluster bomb
[*] Utilization of Maui's ability to transform should make the combat more interesting, this will tie into attack combos
[*] Levels should streamline the story more, this may shorten the games overall length but will open to the door to adding FLC (no that isn't a typo) easier in the future.
[*] There should be an optimization in performance
[/olist]

Thanks for your support and I hope to have the new demo version out soon

notes.title: Hari Matariki
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44874450/2c85296f3b2ccd0e9dac3085a93662f045202522.jpg[/img]
Friday June 28 2024, New Zealand celebrates Matariki, or the Maori New Year.
Matariki, or Nga mata o te arikii o Tawhirmatea (the eyes of Tawhirimatea), is the Maori name for the Pleiades and the celebration occurs as the star cluster rises for the first time (after the first month of the cluster not being visible in New Zealand), marking the beginning of the new lunar calendar.

In celebration of this mark in the calendar [i]The Legends of Maui[/i] demo is to be released.
So get ready to try your hand at being Maui.
You'll also be able to file bug reports if you discover anything.

So kia ora
